faqs.question: Nothing prints. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Try the following:
Make sure that text has been entered.
Replace the tape cartridge, if necessary.
Check the display for an error message and perform the suggested solution.
Replace the batteries with new ones, or use the optional AC adapter (APT0615Z1-1).
Make sure the rear cover is closed.
Check the tape cartridge to make sure the label isn't stuck inside the product.

faqs.question: How do I insert a tape cartridge?
faqs.answer:
Do the following:
Remove any slack from the ink ribbon.
Remove the rear cover, if necessary.
Insert the tape cartridge and press it down firmly until it snaps into place. If there is excess tape, feed the end of the tape through the tape guide slot.
Replace the cover and snap it into place.

faqs.question: My product is on, but the display is black. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Try the following:
Make sure the batteries are inserted correctly.
Replace the batteries with new ones, or use the optional AC adapter (APT0615Z1-1).
Warning
: Make sure to use AC adapter APT0615Z1-1 or damage may occur.
If you are using an AC adapter, make sure that it is securely connected to both the wall outlet and the product.
Adjust the contrast setting.

faqs.question: My saved labels are missing. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Check the following:
Make sure you didn't accidentally delete the text by pressing
+
.
Make sure the product was not reset. If the product is reset, all of the previously entered text will be deleted.
Make sure the AC adapter is securely attached or the batteries are properly seated. If the AC adapter is unplugged or the batteries are removed during operation, the text may be deleted.

faqs.question: Printing stops in the middle of the text. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Try the following:
Install a new tape cartridge.
Replace the batteries or use the optional AC adapter (APT0615Z1-1).

faqs.question: Why does my display turn off?
faqs.answer: The power turns off automatically if the product is idle for more than 5 minutes. Also, if an incorrect button sequence is entered, the display may flicker or turn off for an instant.

faqs.question: I can't attach my label. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Try the following:
Make sure to peel off the backing paper before attaching the label.
Make sure the surface you are attaching to is clean and dry. The label may not adhere to some materials, rough or uneven surfaces, or surfaces subjected to extreme environmental conditions, such as high humidity or heat.
